title: Mobile App Developer
description:
**JD \- Hybrid Mobile App Developer**
 Experience Required: 5 to 7 years
   

  

 The Client is looking for a talented Hybrid Mobile App Developer to join our dynamic team and help us build high\-quality mobile applications using React.js and Ionic frameworks.
   

  

 Skills for a React Native \& Ionic Developer
   

  

* Strong knowledge of React Native, Ionic Framework, and related technologies like Capacitor and Cordova.
* Proficiency in JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, and state management tools.
* Familiarity with native mobile app development (Swift, Objective\-C for iOS and Java/Kotlin for Android) for integrating custom native components.
* Understanding of app release and versioning for app stores, CI/CD processes, and automated testing tools.
* Experience with RESTful APIs and other back\-end integration methodologies.


 Here are the key roles and responsibilities for a React Native and Ionic Mobile App Developer:
   

  

 Cross\-Platform Development
   

  

* Build and maintain mobile applications using React Native and Ionic, enabling cross\-platform functionality on both iOS and Android devices.
* Write reusable, modular, and optimized code primarily in JavaScript, TypeScript, or HTML5/CSS3 to ensure a seamless experience across platforms.
* Utilize native APIs and plugins for device features like GPS, camera, and biometric authentication.


 UI/UX Implementation
   

  

* Work with designers to implement pixel\-perfect UI components, maintaining visual consistency across different devices and screen sizes.
* Develop responsive designs with animations and smooth transitions that enhance the user experience and make the app feel native to the platform.


 Integration with Back\-End Services
   

  

* Connect mobile applications with back\-end services using RESTful APIs for real\-time data sync.
* Ensure efficient data handling and network performance, managing data caching and state effectively using tools like Redux or Context API.


 Testing and Debugging
   

  

* Conduct extensive testing, including unit, integration, and end\-to\-end tests, using tools like Jest, Mocha, or Jasmine for React Native.
* Debug and resolve issues related to platform compatibility, memory usage, and UI performance, ensuring a smooth, bug\-free user experience.


 Platform\-Specific Customizations
   

  

* Write platform\-specific code when necessary, utilizing native code modules for iOS (Swift/Objective\-C) and Android when React Native or Ionic lacks functionality.
* Integrate platform\-specific libraries and adapt features to meet the unique requirements of each platform.


 Continuous Integration and Deployment (CI/CD)
   

  

* Set up CI/CD pipelines for automated builds, testing, and deployment, using tools like Jenkins or GitHub Actions.
* Prepare applications for app store releases, following the guidelines and best practices for both the Apple App Store and Google Play Store.


 Performance Optimization
   

  

* Optimize the performance of mobile applications to enhance load times, memory usage, and responsiveness.
* Implement lazy loading, caching strategies, and optimization techniques to handle large data sets and improve the app's responsiveness.


 Security Best Practices
   

  

* Ensure data protection and app security by implementing best practices for encryption, secure storage, and authentication.
* Regularly update dependencies and third\-party libraries to minimize vulnerabilities and maintain security compliance.


 Stay Updated on Framework Changes
   

  

* Stay current with the latest updates in React Native, Ionic, and their respective ecosystems, such as new libraries, tools, and language features.
* Apply modern development practices, such as hooks in React Native or Capacitor updates in Ionic, to improve application quality and performance.

title: Software Development Engineer -2 (Mobile)
description:
**ABOUT QUINCE**
 Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer\-to\-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.
   

  

 What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross\-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.
   

  

**OUR CULTURE**
 Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.
   

  

* We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long\-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade\-off has to exist in the first place.
* Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
* Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member \- no matter their level \- has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.


 If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug\-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.
   

  

**THE ROLE**
**Software Development Engineer 2 – Mobile**
 We’re looking for a
 **Software Development Engineer II – Mobile** 
 to join our growing engineering team and help build high\-performance mobile experiences for Quince customers. In this role, you will design, develop, and optimize React Native applications that deliver fast, reliable, and seamless experiences at scale.
   

  

 You will take ownership of mobile features and technical problems, with a strong focus on performance, scalability, code quality, and user experience. You’ll work closely with Product, Design, and Backend teams to build reliable mobile solutions while contributing to the continuous improvement of Quince’s mobile applications.
   

  

 This role is ideal for an engineer who is passionate about mobile development, enjoys solving React Native challenges, and cares deeply about building high\-quality experiences for customers.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Mobile Application Development**
* Design, develop, and maintain high\-quality mobile applications using React Native.
* Build reusable, maintainable, and efficient components following modern mobile engineering best practices.
* Take ownership of features and modules from development through testing and production release.
* Work with existing libraries, frameworks, and architectural patterns to build scalable mobile solutions.
* Identify opportunities to improve the quality, maintainability, and performance of the mobile application.


**Performance \& Optimization**
* Improve mobile application performance across rendering, startup time, responsiveness, memory usage, and stability.
* Identify and resolve unnecessary re\-renders and inefficient rendering patterns.
* Optimize large lists and complex UI interactions to deliver smooth experiences across devices.
* Use profiling and debugging tools to identify performance bottlenecks and implement appropriate solutions.
* Apply mobile performance best practices during feature development and code reviews.


**React Native \& Native Platform Engineering**
* Build and optimize mobile experiences using technologies such as FlashList, React Native Reanimated, React Native Gesture Handler, and Expo.
* Troubleshoot React Native issues across JavaScript and native layers.
* Investigate platform\-specific issues across iOS and Android.
* Work with React Native's native capabilities and TurboModules when required.
* Collaborate with senior engineers when native iOS or Android code is required to address platform\-specific or performance\-related issues.


**Quality \& Reliability**
* Develop and maintain test cases to ensure the quality and reliability of mobile applications.
* Debug and resolve development and production issues in a timely manner.
* Contribute to improving application stability, performance, and release quality.
* Participate in code reviews and provide feedback on implementation quality, performance, and maintainability.
* Follow engineering standards for testing, documentation, and production readiness.


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**
* Partner with Product, Design, Backend, and other engineering teams to define and implement mobile features.
* Translate product and customer requirements into scalable and maintainable technical solutions.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to identify technical dependencies and resolve implementation challenges.
* Communicate technical decisions, progress, and trade\-offs clearly with relevant stakeholders.


**Technical Contribution \& Mentorship**
* Contribute to technical discussions and design decisions within the mobile team.
* Share knowledge and best practices with other engineers.
* Provide guidance and support to junior engineers when required.
* Stay current with developments in React Native, mobile platforms, and mobile performance techniques.
* Contribute to improving engineering practices, development workflows, and overall mobile application quality.


**Qualifications**
**Required:**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 2–4 years of professional experience in software, frontend, or mobile engineering.
* 2\+ years of hands\-on experience building production applications with React Native.
* Strong proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript with a solid understanding of React Native fundamentals.
* Good understanding of mobile application architecture, rendering, state management, and performance optimization.
* Hands\-on experience optimizing React Native applications, including render cycles, unnecessary re\-renders, memory usage, and application responsiveness.
* Experience troubleshooting React Native issues across the JavaScript and native layers.
* Experience with modern React Native libraries such as FlashList, React Native Reanimated, React Native Gesture Handler, and Expo.
* Proficiency with debugging tools such as Flipper, React DevTools, and Chrome DevTools.
* Familiarity with iOS and Android platform fundamentals.
* Exposure to TurboModules and native iOS/Android development is preferred.
* Strong problem\-solving skills with a focus on performance, quality, and customer experience.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across functions.


**Preferred:**
* Experience building consumer\-facing mobile applications.
* Experience with React Native performance profiling and optimization.
* Familiarity with the New React Native Architecture, including JSI, Fabric, and TurboModules.
* Experience integrating third\-party native SDKs or working with native modules across iOS and Android.
* Experience with mobile CI/CD and automated release workflows, including tools such as Expo Application Services (EAS).
* Experience with mobile observability, crash reporting, performance monitoring, and analytics.
* Experience in e\-commerce, retail, or other high\-scale consumer applications.
* Experience mentoring junior engineers or contributing to mobile engineering standards.


**WHY QUINCE?**
 Joining Quince means being part of a mission\-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.
   

  

**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY \& HIRING INTEGRITY**
 Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.
   

  

 Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case\-by\-case basis.
   

  

 Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.
   

  

*Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds*
 At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit\-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.

title: Senior Mobile Software Engineer (iOS / Android), Identity & Security - India
description:
**All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.** 



  

 About JumpCloud®
   


 JumpCloud® is the AI\-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.
 


  


  
 


  

**JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.** 
  





  




 Position Overview
   


  

 We are looking for a Senior Mobile Software Engineer with 8–12 years of native development experience to drive core features for our suite of mobile security applications—including JumpCloud Protect, Mobile Authenticator Factor Application (MAFA), and our converged Password Vault. In this role, you will architect secure, resilient mobile experiences, implement low\-level system integrations (autofill, biometrics, secure storage), and collaborate with platform backend teams to protect enterprise identities worldwide.
 




  




**What You Will Do:** 
  
* **Core Feature Delivery:** 
 Architect, build, and ship high\-performance, native iOS (Swift) and Android (Kotlin) features across mobile authentication, password management, and identity verification apps.
  
* **Security \& Auth Infrastructure:** 
 Implement critical mobile security mechanisms, including Credential Provider / Autofill framework integrations, biometric authentication (FaceID/TouchID/BiometricPrompt), hardware\-backed secure storage (Keychain, Keystore, Secure Enclave), and OIDC/OAuth2 authentication flows.
  
* **Release Hygiene \& Quality Ownership:** 
 Drive release pipelines for the Apple App Store and Google Play Store. Maintain strict UI testing coverage targets using XCTest and Espresso, while establishing mobile E2E integration test suites with core platform APIs.
  
* **Problem solving \& Troubleshooting:** 
 Active participation in the incident management process and contributing PIRs, taking ownership/accountability for a quick turn\-around to resolve the incident.
  
* **AI Adoption \& Technical Leadership:** 
 Champion the BMAD framework to establish governance and structure for AI\-assisted workflows (Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot). Mentor engineers, conduct RFC reviews, and build shared team skill libraries.
  

  



  




**Required Technical Qualifications** 
  

  
* **Experience:** 
 8–12 years of professional software development experience focused primarily on native mobile app delivery.
  
* **Language Mastery:** 
 Expert\-level proficiency in Swift or Kotlin, with strong working knowledge or willingness to work across both platforms.
  
* **Mobile Security \& Encryption:** 
 Deep understanding of App Transport Security (ATS), network security configuration, certificate pinning trade\-offs, jailbreak/root detection, and cryptography best practices.
  
* **Testing \& Automation:** 
 Hands\-on experience writing unit, UI, and integration tests using XCTest, Espresso, or modern E2E automation tools.
  
* **CI/CD \& Analytics:** 
 Experience setting up mobile Continuous Integration pipelines (e.g., Bitrise, Fastlane, GitHub Actions) and leveraging crash reporting platforms (Firebase Crashlytics, Sentry) for real\-world telemetry and debugging.
  
* **Networking \& Protocols:** 
 Proven track record integrating RESTful APIs, WebSockets, and OIDC client libraries into reactive mobile architectures.
  
* Prior experience developing enterprise security, Password Vault, or Multi\-Factor Authentication (MFA) applications.
  

  


  

  
* Production experience with native desktop extensions or cross\-platform security modules.
  

  


  


  




**Nice to have skills:** 
  

  
* **Cloud Technology:** 
 Experienced working with AWS \& GCPcloud services
  
* **Back\-end:** 
 Experience with developing backend modules using Golang or equivalent languages.
  

  


  





  




  


  





**Where you’ll be working/Location:** 



  



 JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.
 



  


  
 


  


**You must be located in and authorized to work in the country noted in the job description to be considered for this role.** 



  


  
 


  



 Please note: There is an expectation that our engineers participate in on\-call shifts. You will be expected commit to being ready and able to respond during your assigned shift, so that alerts don't go unaddressed.
 



  


  
 


  


**Language:** 



  



 JumpCloud has teams in 15\+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently.  Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.
 



  


  
 


  


**Why JumpCloud?** 

  
 



  



 If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS\-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.  
 



  



  
 



  



 One of JumpCloud's three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." \- Rajat Bhargava, CEO
 



  



  
 



  



 Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud.  Please note JumpCloud is not accepting third party resumes at this time.   
 



  



  
 



  



 JumpCloud is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.
 



  


  
 


  



**Scam Notice:** 




  



 Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment.
 



  


  
 


  



 All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at recruiting@jumpcloud.com with the subject line "Scam Notice" 
 



  



  
 



  



 \#BI\-Remote
 



  


 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, transcribing or summarizing interviews, and assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment in hiring decisions, which are ultimately made by humans. Please see our Privacy Policy (https://jumpcloud.com/privacy) for more information about our personal data practices.

title: System Engineer - HMI
description:
**Hello Visionary!**
 We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly changing world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make an outstanding addition to our vibrant team. Siemens Mobility is an independent run company of Siemens AG. Its core business includes rail vehicles, rail automation and electrification solutions, turnkey systems, intelligent road traffic technology and related services. In Mobility, we help our customers meet the need for hard\-working mobility solutions. We’re making the lives of people who travel easier and more enjoyable while constantly developing new, intelligent mobility solutions!
   

  

**We are looking for** 
**System Engineer – HMI**
**You’ll make a difference by**
**Responsibilities**
 As a System Engineer – HMI, you will be responsible design and developing software of HMI for our our innovative rail vehicles. Your task, and responsibilities are as follows:
   

  

* Ensure accurate, error\-free, clear and real\-time visualization on the driver's cab display system, meeting functional and safety requirements.
* The result of your work is high\-quality display software whose interfaces to the train control or train control system function smoothly.
* Collect and structure system and customer requirements, develop solution concepts, and define software architectures in close collaboration with cross\-functional engineering teams.
* You should be able to implement upgradation / new work of application software with end\-to\-end responsibility using V model approach.
* Define, generate, and integrate application data and parameters required to customize HMI functionality at the TMS subsystem level, in accordance with project specifications and design.
* Support the adaptation and configuration of HMI applications, with the goal of taking full responsibility/ownership of these processes in the medium term.
* Plan and perform software integration and system\-level testing, verifying functionality in laboratory environments and directly on vehicles.
* Ensure reliable, high\-quality display software with seamless integration to vehicle control systems and subsystems.
* Take full responsibility for implementing upgrades or new features in application software using a V\-model\-based development process, in compliance with EN 50657 / EN 50716\.
* Create software test specifications, participate in code reviews, and support design verification activities.
* Contribute to the creation and maintenance of comprehensive technical documentation.
* Support system integration and validation testing activities during project execution and commissioning phases.


**Desired Skills**
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree with a focus on electrical engineering, electronics engineering, computer science/software engineering, electrical engineering, or similar.
* Minimum 5 years of hands\-on experience with object\-oriented programming using C\+\+, Qt, and QML.
* Experience with UI design for rail vehicles is a plus.
* Strong understanding and proven experience with requirement engineering.
* Familiarity with railway standards such as EN 50657 / EN 50716 is advantageous.
* Solid understanding of operating systems (especially Linux and Windows for Workgroups).
* Comfortable working with current operating systems and virtualization software (VMware, VirtualBox, Windows 11\).

title: Senior Technical Consultant, Products
description:
**About Workhall** 




 Workhall is a bootstrapped low\-code / no\-code enterprise workflow platform. We help large organisations model complex operations as configurable data structures, workflows, and reports, without the cost and drag of bespoke custom development. Today we serve 30\+ enterprise customers across India, Australia, and the Americas, in industries ranging from manufacturing, food and beverage, and pharma to construction, trade, and private capital. Our products team is building focused vertical products on top of the platform. Two are the primary focus
 



 for the current cycle: OpsPulse, our unified EHS, quality, and compliance product for industrial and
 



 regulated sectors, and DealPulse, our deal and portfolio management product for multi\-asset private capital. This role sits at the centre of that push.
 



  





**About the role** 




 You will be the technical backbone that turns the Workhall platform into working enterprise solutions. Sitting inside the products team, you own solution design and hands\-on build for our focus products, solve the hard data\-modelling and integration problems that complex customers bring, and act as the deep technical reference point for our delivery teams and implementation partners. This is a senior, hands\-on solutioning role for someone who is equally comfortable whiteboarding an architecture and configuring the platform themselves. You are not just advising from the sidelines. You design, you build, and you set the standard others follow.
 



  





**What you will do** 




*Solution design and architecture* 




 • Own end\-to\-end solution design on the platform: data models, workflows, roles and permissions,
 



 reports, and the expression logic that ties them together.
 



 • Translate ambiguous enterprise requirements into robust, scalable, maintainable configurations
 



 rather than one\-off hacks.
 



 • Make and defend data\-modelling decisions, including denormalization and relationship patterns,
 



 with an eye on performance and long\-term maintainability on a document\-database platform.
 



*Build and delivery* 




 • Configure and build complex solutions across our focus products, OpsPulse and DealPulse, and
 



 step into other verticals when needed.
 



 • Design and implement integrations between Workhall and external enterprise systems.
 



 • Own the hardest technical parts of an implementation, and unblock delivery teams when they hit the limits of the platform or the data model.
 



*Customer and stakeholder engagement* 




 • Run technical discovery workshops with enterprise customers, shape the solution, and
 



 communicate trade\-offs to both technical and business stakeholders.
 



 • Act as a trusted technical advisor through an implementation, from design through go\-live and
 



 stabilisation.
 



*Partner enablement and quality* 




 • Enable, review, and raise the quality bar for implementation partners so delivery stays consistent as we scale.
 



 • Define reusable patterns, templates, and technical standards that the wider delivery ecosystem can adopt.
 



*Product feedback loop* 




 • Bring real customer and delivery friction back into the products team so it shapes the roadmap and the platform itself.
 



  





**What we are looking for** 




 •
 **Experience** 
 . 5\+ years in enterprise software implementation, solution consulting, or technical
 



 delivery, including meaningful time on low\-code / no\-code, BPM, or workflow automation platforms.
 



 •
 **Data modelling** 
 . Strong data\-modelling instincts and comfort with document or NoSQL databases;
 



 MongoDB experience is a clear advantage.
 



 •
 **Platform depth** 
 . Ability to reason about workflow logic, conditional expressions, and integrations
 



 from first principles, not just by copying prior examples.
 



 •
 **Communication.** 
 Customer\-facing maturity: you can run a workshop, defend a design decision,
 



 manage expectations, and say no well.
 



 •
 **Ownership** 
 . A track record of owning the technically hardest part of a project and getting it live.
 



  





**Nice to have** 




 • Domain exposure to EHS, quality management, or governance, risk and compliance (for OpsPulse), or to private capital and fund operations (for DealPulse).
 



 • Experience enabling a partner or delivery ecosystem, or leading a small technical team.
 



 • Familiarity with API design, scripting, or integration middleware.
 



  





**What success looks like** 




 •
 **By 30 days** 
 : First 30 days: fluent in the platform's core building blocks and able to configure a
 



 working solution end to end.
 



 •
 **By 90 days** 
 : First 90 days: leading the solution design on at least one complex customer
 



 implementation and setting technical patterns others reuse.
 



 •
 **By 6 months** 
 : First 6 months: the go\-to technical authority for your focus product, with partners and delivery teams delivering to a visibly higher standard.
 



  





**Why join us** 




 •
 **Ownership.** 
 Real ownership. We are a lean, bootstrapped team, so your work ships and your
 



 judgement counts from week one.
 



 •
 **Depth** 
 . Hard, interesting problems. Modelling messy enterprise operations into clean, reusable
 



 software is genuinely difficult and genuinely rewarding.
 



 •
 **Range** 
 . Breadth of exposure. You will work across regulated industries and global markets, not a
 



 single narrow use case.
 



 •
 **Leverage** 
 . A platform with leverage. What you build once serves many customers and many
 



 verticals.

**AI\-Assisted Engineering**

* Code generation and refactoring
* Test case generation
* Technical documentation
* Code analysis and troubleshooting
* Design and development acceleration
* Experiment with AI\-assisted development approaches and rapidly build POCs and prototypes to validate technical and business requirements.
* Apply spec\-driven development practices to improve consistency and quality across the development lifecycle.
* Explore and contribute to solutions using modern AI engineering approaches such as RAG, MCP, and automation tools.


**Software Design \& Development**
* Contribute to the design and development of API\-first and microservices\-based applications.
* Develop and maintain high\-quality backend APIs and frontend applications using technologies such as: Java / Spring Boot, Node.js, Python, React / Angular
* Follow OpenAPI specifications, enterprise development standards, and established architectural guidelines.

* Integrate applications with existing enterprise platforms, services, and databases.


**Quality Engineering**
* Develop automated tests covering: Unit testing, API testing, Integration testing, Functional testing
* Use AI\-assisted approaches to improve test coverage and identify potential defects.
* Apply secure coding practices and contribute to addressing security vulnerabilities.
* Consider performance, scalability, reliability, and maintainability as part of development activities.


**Cloud, DevOps \& SRE**
* Develop and deploy applications using cloud\-based environments, preferably AWS.
* Contribute to CI/CD pipeline development and automation.
* Work with DevOps teams to improve build, deployment, and release processes.
* Contribute to application monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability.
* Support investigation and resolution of production issues and contribute to root\-cause analysis.
* Help implement improvements to application resilience, performance, and recoverability.


**Collaboration \& Delivery**
* Work closely with product managers, business teams, architects, senior engineers, and operations teams to understand requirements and deliver solutions.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies including refinement, planning, reviews, and retrospectives.
* Communicate technical challenges, risks, dependencies, and progress effectively.
* Contribute ideas for improving engineering practices, automation, quality, and developer productivity.
* Continuously learn and adopt new engineering and AI\-assisted development practices.


**Technical Skills**
**Essential Skills / Experience**
* Good hands\-on experience in software development using one or more of: Java / Spring Boot, Node.js, Python
* Experience with at least one modern frontend framework, such as: React, Angular or similar
* Understanding of REST APIs and API\-first development.
* Working knowledge of microservices architecture and distributed application concepts.
* Experience working with PostgreSQL, Oracle, or another relational database.
* Basic to good understanding of AWS or another cloud platform.
* Experience with Git, CI/CD, and DevOps practices.


**AI \& Modern Engineering**
* Hands\-on exposure to AI\-assisted coding and software development tools.
* Understanding of how AI can be used for: Code generation, Code review, Test generation, Documentation, Debugging, Technical design.
* Awareness of modern AI engineering concepts such as: RAG, MCP, AI agents, Prompt/spec\-driven development, Developer automation
* Interest in exploring and applying AI to improve software engineering productivity and quality.


**Engineering Practices**
* Understanding of OpenAPI specifications and RESTful API design.
* Good understanding of software engineering fundamentals including: SOLID principles, Design patterns, Exception handling, Logging, Security, Performance \& Scalability
* Understanding of automated testing and test\-driven/quality\-focused development practices.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
* Telecom/domain experience would be an advantage but is not essential.


**Soft Skills**
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Good communication and collaboration skills.
* Ability to work effectively with senior engineers, architects, product teams, and other stakeholders.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-changing technology environment.
* Willingness to learn new technologies and experiment with emerging AI and software engineering tools.
* Ability to take ownership of assigned technical tasks while seeking guidance when required.


 BT is the UK’s leading communications group and the holding company behind some of the country’s most recognised brands – including BT, EE, Openreach and Plusnet. Our purpose is as simple as it is ambitious: we connect for good. Our customers include consumers, small, medium and large businesses, public sector organisations and other communications providers.
   

  

 BT 's role is about setting direction, unlocking value and creating the conditions for our brands and businesses to thrive.
   

  

 Having come through the most capital\-intensive phase of our fibre investment, our focus now is on what comes next – simplifying how we operate, using technology and AI to work smarter, and organising ourselves to serve customers better and grow sustainably. Group teams shape strategy, policy, brand, capital allocation and transformation, helping the whole organisation perform at its best.
   

  

 We have a singular culture that unites all our people: we are customer\-first challengers, who are committed, clear and connected. These behaviours unite us as one team to deliver for our colleagues, our customers, our stakeholders and the country. Joining BT Group means working at the heart of a business that matters to the UK, with the opportunity to shape decisions, influence outcomes and help set the future course of one of the country’s most important companies.

title: Technical Lead
description:
**About Lila Games:** 




 Lila Games strives to build a world\-class engineering team (eventually) that can compete with the best in the world. We are a long way from that ambition, but we hope to find others to help us build this team from Bangalore, India. Built in India, published to the world.
 



 More information about Lila:
 
 https://tr.ee/7DD\-CnUfci
 




  





**Why This Role Exists:** 




 We are a multi\-game studio, and our biggest constraint is how fast we can ship new games. We need a Tech Lead who helps us ship new games faster, both by working directly on the games and by building the shared systems and tooling that multiple projects reuse.
 



 This is a full\-stack, full\-lifecycle role. The work spans backend and frontend, in Unity, Godot, or whatever a project uses. You should be comfortable picking up new tech stacks fast. You will not be boxed into one engine or one game.
 



  





**What You Will Own:** 



* **Build shared foundations and systems:** 
 Design the systems and tooling that multiple projects reuse, so new games start from a stronger base instead of rebuilding the same things each time.
* **Build for liveops operability from day one:** 
 Every feature you ship should be operable without engineering involvement after launch. Designers should be able to adjust weapon balance, drop rates, event timing, and economy levers through config or dashboards, not by filing engineering tickets. Think about who operates what you build, not just whether it works on launch day.
* **Design scalable features:** 
 Architect features that hold up as a game grows in players and content, and that work across projects rather than being rebuilt each time.
* **Build testable systems, not just tested systems:** 
 Pure logic (economy calculations, matchmaking, config parsing, anything that does not touch the engine) should be unit tested. Gameplay systems should be designed so their logic can be validated without running the full game. You do not need TDD dogma everywhere, but you must know what to test, what not to test, and how to architect so testing is possible.
* **Own features end to end across projects:** 
 Take features from scoping to shipped, across backend and frontend, often on more than one game at a time. Translate requirements into well\-scoped engineering tasks with realistic estimates, in collaboration with product and design.
* **Lead and mentor the engineering team in Bangalore:** 
 Most engineers have not received structured technical feedback. Code review is your primary mentorship tool: specific, technical, and instructive. Your goal is to raise the floor of every engineer around you.



  





**Working With AI:** 




 You should be comfortable building with AI agents as part of your normal workflow:
 


* **Agentic coding:** 
 using AI agents to write and ship code day to day.
* **Agentic loops with guardrails:** 
 setting up workflows where agents do real work within constraints and checks you define.
* **Self\-healing agent loops:** 
 workflows that detect their own failures and correct themselves.



  





**What We Are Looking For:** 




 We care more about depth of skill and quality of thinking than years of experience. Here is what actually matters:
 


* **Strong engineering fundamentals:** 
 you understand SOLID principles and can explain why they matter in the context of a game codebase, specifically why they make live\-ops changes safer and faster, not just cleaner.
* **Full\-stack and quick with new stacks:** 
 you are comfortable across backend and frontend (Unity, React, or whatever a project uses) and you pick up unfamiliar tech stacks fast.
* **Hands\-on agentic coder:** 
 you write code day to day and use AI agents to do it. You are comfortable with agentic loops and the guardrails that keep them reliable. This is not a management\-from\-a\-distance role.
* **Liveops systems thinking:** 
 you have worked on a live game and understand what it means to build features that can be tuned, toggled, or updated without a full build. You think about config, feature flags, and content pipelines as engineering concerns, not product team problems.
* **Mentorship instinct:** 
 you give direct, specific technical feedback. You can explain not just what is wrong but why and how to fix it.
* **High agency:** 
 you identify problems and propose solutions without waiting to be asked. You own outcomes, not tasks.



 Unity proficiency is a bonus. Backend or networking experience is valuable given the multiplayer games that we work on.
 



  





**What We Are Not Looking For:** 



* Engineers who equate years of experience with expertise. We have seen too many senior engineers with bad habits and too many sharp 4\-year engineers who outperform them.
* People who profile only when performance is already broken. By then it is too late.
* Engineers who build features without thinking about who operates them post\-launch. Liveops operability is an engineering responsibility.
* People who prefer to manage from a distance. We need someone in the code.



  





**Application Process:** 




**Apply:** 
 submit your resume. We respond within 3 business days.
 



**Written Assignment:** 
 we send this first, a focused technical problem designed to surface how you think, not just what you know. You may use AI tools, but you must fully understand what you submit.
 



**First Interview:** 
 a combined screening and technical and cultural conversation with our leadership team.
 



**Final Interview:** 
 a conversation with a founder, including a walkthrough of your assignment.
 



**Offer:** 
 formal offer with compensation details.
 



 Please review our company values at
 
 https://bit.ly/3rsN1ti
 
 before applying. Cultural fit is not a formality here. It is a filter.

**Senior Software Engineer \- Android, Bangalore**




  


**About Warner Bros. Discovery:**




 Warner Bros. Discovery, a premier global media and entertainment company, offers audiences the world's most differentiated and complete portfolio of content, brands and franchises across television, film, streaming and gaming. The new company combines Warner Media’s premium entertainment, sports and news assets with Discovery's leading non\-fiction and international entertainment and sports businesses.
 



 For more information, please visit www.wbd.com
 



  


**Meet Our Team:**




 We are the Product Engineering group for Direct\-2\-Consumer business, and responsible for building OTT Player (HLS and DASH) for several Warner Bros. Discovery products across 17 different platforms. We build Player SDK for Android, Apple, Desktop, HWA and STB platforms to provide seamless integration experience to the WBD applications.
 



 The ideal candidate has a track record of having built multiple high\-performance, stable, scalable Android applications, JAVA / Kotlin tech stack, Jetpack Compose, HLS / DASH Players and expertise in Software Architecture / Design principles. You are customer obsessed and always challenge yourself to provide the best quality playback experience to the WBD users. You are a team player and collaborate with peers and guide SDE\-Is. You help your architect in grooming the backlog and estimations. You are obsessed about Operational Excellence and always strive for engineering excellence. You show good judgment making trade\-offs between immediate and long\-term business needs.

* Advocate best practices for Player Design \& Development.

 **Kotlin.**
* Hands\-on experience in building native Android applications and mobility solutions.

 **Media Player APIs, EXO Player API** 
 ,
 **Android SDK** 
 , Core Java, Android Studio IDE, Compose Framework, Android Debugger, Android Open Source, Kotlin.

* Familiar with Web Service Integration (REST, JSON) and REST concepts
* Experience in DevOps/SRE practices such as CI/CD, performance monitoring \& incident management

* Self\-confident, self\-starter – proactive in setting and meeting goals, with limited supervision
* Good verbal \& written communication skills

* A Great Place to work

 This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. You can find them at

 along with some insights from the team on what they mean and how they show up in their day to day. We hope they resonate with you and look forward to discussing them during your interview.

title: Lead Software Engineer- iOS
description:
**Company Overview**
 Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1\.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business\-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the \#1 company in e\-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).
   

  

 What you'll do
   

  

 Docusign's Mobile Engineering team builds and operates complex solutions for global business challenges that cross cultures, legal jurisdictions, and impact millions of businesses every day. We are looking for a Lead Software Engineer (P5\) to be at the forefront of driving technical design, feature implementation, and ongoing evolution for our native iOS applications and customer\-facing iOS SDKs. Our iOS SDKs empower enterprise customers and third\-party developers to seamlessly integrate Docusign's Intelligent Agreement Management platform directly into their own mobile applications. In this role, you will act as a primary technical authority, balancing hands\-on architecture and high\-performance Swift development with cross\-team leadership. You will work closely with Product, Design, QA, and backend platform teams, while occasionally engaging with enterprise partners to ensure our SDKs and native app experiences are secure, performant, and intuitive to integrate.
   

  

 This position is an individual contributor role reporting to Senior Director, Engineering.
   

  

****Responsibility****
* Drive the end\-to\-end architectural vision, API design, and implementation for native iOS applications and developer\-facing iOS SDKs
* Write clean, modular, and well\-tested Swift code, creating robust public API interfaces and XCFrameworks for enterprise integration
* Set high standards for code quality, conducting thorough code reviews and establishing best practices across testing, modularity, and security
* Partner with Product, Design, QA, and backend engineering to ensure mobile features align with platform APIs and enterprise scalability requirements
* Collaborate with enterprise developer partners to understand integration requirements, collect feedback, and ensure smooth SDK adoption
* Mentor and coach engineers across the team, elevating technical capability and fostering a culture of continuous learning
* Proactively identify opportunities to optimize build pipelines, continuous integration, testing automation, and release speed
* Stay ahead of Apple platform developments, WWDC updates, and iOS trends, adopting new technologies where they deliver clear value


 Job Designation
   

  

**Hybrid:** 
 Employee divides their time between in\-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in\-office expectation)
   

  

 Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.
   

  

 What you bring
   

  

**Basic**
* B.S. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
* 10\+ years of professional software engineering experience in cloud, SaaS, or enterprise software environments
* 5\+ years specifically building production native iOS applications and public or internal iOS SDKs backed by cloud APIs
* 3\+ years of deep, hands\-on experience with Swift (along with working knowledge of Objective\-C for legacy codebase interoperability)
* Demonstrated experience designing clean, maintainable SDK APIs, modular architectures, and managing library distribution (such as Swift Package Manager and CocoaPods)
* Proven track record of mentoring engineers and leading complex technical initiatives across cross\-functional teams


**Preferred**
* M.S. in Computer Science or a related technical field
* Experience managing binary framework packaging (XCFrameworks), semantic versioning, and SDK deprecation cycles
* Deep knowledge of modern iOS frameworks, Swift Concurrency, memory management, and security protocols (OAuth, SSO, and data encryption at rest)
* Familiarity with Android development principles or cross\-platform SDK design considerations
* Active contributions to open\-source iOS libraries, developer blog posts, or tech community speaking engagements


 Life at Docusign
   

  

**Working here**
 Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.
   

  

 We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live.
   

  

**Accommodation**
 Docusign is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need such an accommodation, or a religious accommodation, during the application process, please contact us at accommodations@docusign.com.
   

  

 If you experience any issues, concerns, or technical difficulties during the application process please get in touch with our Talent organization at taops@docusign.com for assistance.
   

  

 Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice

 Your Role
   

  

* Design, develop, and enhance SAP Fiori/UI5 applications for SAP ECC and SAP S/4HANA landscapes.
* Build and consume OData services using SAP Gateway (SEGW) and develop responsive applications using SAPUI5, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, XML, and JSON.
* Configure and manage SAP Fiori Launchpad, including catalogs, groups, spaces, roles, and application deployments.
* Collaborate with business and functional teams to deliver technical solutions, perform testing, troubleshooting, performance optimization, and production support.
* Prepare technical design documents and participate in Agile/Scrum\-based project delivery.


 Your Profile

title: Software Engineering Intern
description:
**Company Description**
 Abstrabit is a Private AI engineering company building AI\-powered products and solutions for businesses. We work across the AI stack — from deploying and evaluating private and open\-weight models to building production applications, agents, workflows, and integrations on top of them.
   

  

 Our engineering work is organized across two closely connected layers: the
 **AI layer** 
 , focused on models, inference, evaluation, and AI infrastructure; and the
 **application layer** 
 , focused on building reliable, scalable software products that use those AI capabilities.
   

  

**The Context**
 AI models are only one part of a production AI system.
   

  

 They still need applications around them — APIs, workflows, user interfaces, authentication, databases, integrations, monitoring, and reliable production infrastructure.
   

  

 Our Software Engineering team owns this application layer.
   

  

 As we build more AI\-powered products, we are looking for engineers who want to become strong software developers while working close to modern AI systems.
   

  

**Job Description**
 As a
 **Software Engineering Intern** 
 , you will work primarily on the application layer of our AI products.
   

  

 You will build frontend and backend features, APIs, integrations, workflows, and other product components that connect with AI models and inference services.
   

  

 You will work with experienced engineers on real production systems using technologies such as
 **TypeScript, Node.js, React, Next.js, databases, APIs, and cloud services** 
 .
   

  

 You will also gain exposure to how systems such as LLMs, RAG pipelines, AI agents, and private model inference are integrated into production applications.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on engineering role. You will be expected to write code, debug problems, understand the systems you are working on, and gradually take ownership of larger pieces of the product.
   

  

**What You'll Work On**
 Depending on the project, you may work on:
   

  

* Building frontend and backend product features.
* Designing and consuming REST APIs and internal services.
* Working with databases, authentication, file storage, and third\-party integrations.
* Connecting applications with AI models, inference APIs, RAG systems, and AI agents.
* Debugging application issues across frontend, backend, and integrations.
* Writing tests and improving the reliability of existing features.
* Deploying and maintaining applications using cloud platforms and modern deployment tools.
* Reviewing your work with experienced engineers and improving it based on technical feedback.


 You will not be restricted to isolated internship exercises. The objective is for you to contribute to software that is actually being built and used.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 We care more about your engineering fundamentals and ability to learn than the number of frameworks listed on your resume.
   

  

**You should have:**
* Good programming fundamentals and problem\-solving ability.
* Working knowledge of at least one programming language.
* Basic understanding of web applications, APIs, databases, and Git.
* Experience building at least one meaningful software project through coursework, a personal project, internship, hackathon, or similar work.
* Ability to understand existing code and make changes to it.
* Willingness to investigate problems instead of stopping at the first solution that appears to work.
* Ability to communicate clearly when you are stuck, disagree with an approach, or need more context.


 Familiarity with JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Node.js, or similar technologies will help, but we do not expect interns to already know our complete technology stack.
   

  

**Using AI as an Engineer**
 We use AI tools as part of our engineering workflow, and you are welcome to use them.
   

  

 We do not evaluate engineers based on how much code they can type from memory.
   

  

 What matters is whether you can
 **understand the code you produce, question incorrect suggestions, test your implementation, debug failures, and explain the decisions you made.**
 AI can help you write code. You are still responsible for the result.
   

  

 Additional Information
   

  

**What This Role Is Not**
 This is
 **not an AI research or model\-training role** 
 .
   

  

 Your primary responsibility will be software and product engineering at the application layer.
   

  

 You will work close to our AI engineering team and gain visibility into model inference, RAG, agents, and Private AI infrastructure, but your core focus will be building the applications that make those capabilities useful.
   

  

 This is also not an internship where you spend your time only watching tutorials or completing disconnected training assignments.
   

  

 You will learn by working on real engineering problems with support from the team.
   

  

**Why Join Abstrabit**
 You will get the opportunity to build software in an environment where traditional application engineering and modern AI systems meet.
   

  

 You will:
   

  

* Work on real AI\-powered products rather than demo projects.
* Learn how production applications interact with private and open\-weight AI models.
* Work across frontend, backend, APIs, databases, cloud infrastructure, and AI integrations.
* Receive regular technical feedback and code reviews from experienced engineers.
* Gradually take ownership of larger features as your engineering ability improves.
* Get exposure to both the application engineering and AI engineering sides of modern AI systems.


 For engineers early in their careers, we believe understanding both sides will become increasingly valuable.
   

  

**Our Interview Process**
**Step 1: Application Screening \-** 
 We review basic eligibility, projects, and evidence that you have spent time building and experimenting with technology.
   

  

**Step 2: Practical Engineering Assessment \& Discussion \-** 
 You will work through a practical engineering problem and discuss your approach with one of our engineers.
   

  

 We may ask you to explain your solution, debug an issue, make a small change, or reason through an alternative approach. We are interested in how you use available tools, validate your work, and respond when something does not work as expected.
   

  

**Step 3 \- Final Conversation**
 A discussion about the role, your learning goals, expectations, and whether Abstrabit is the right environment for you.

title: Flutter Engineer - SDE 3
description:
About Bytebeam
 
 Bytebeam builds the platform and applications that keep connected devices — and the teams that operate them — online, observable, and manageable at scale. Checkout https://www.bytebeam.io/
 


 About the role
 
 You will build and own features end to end in our fleet management application: a data\-heavy, map\-centric product that gives fleet operators a live view of their vehicles — real\-time telemetry from CAN and GPS, alerts and driver workflows, and dashboards spanning EV, diesel, and CNG fleets.
 



 This is a senior hands\-on engineering role. We are looking for someone who can take ambiguous product requirements, design a maintainable technical approach, ship tested production code, and help raise the quality of the Flutter codebase through reviews, debugging, and steady engineering judgment.
 



 You will work closely with product, design, backend, and QA, and will be expected to own meaningful feature areas rather than only execute well\-scoped tickets.
 


 What you'll work on
 * Live telemetry dashboards: vehicle status, instrument clusters, alert lifecycles, and threshold\-driven indicators across multiple powertrain types.
* Map\-based UX: live vehicle tracking, route replay, nearby points of interest, geocoding.
* Honest data presentation — a core product principle: staleness indicators, degraded states, and fallbacks that never show stale or fabricated readings as live.
* High\-fidelity UI implementation: translating detailed designs into pixel\-accurate, regression\-tested Flutter widgets.
* An established, deliberately simple architecture — feature\-first modules, lightweight state management, strong test discipline — that you'll work within and help evolve.


 Responsibilities
 * Own medium\-to\-large Flutter features from technical design through release, including edge cases, tests, and production follow\-up.
* Build and ship production\-quality Flutter and Dart code that is maintainable, testable, and easy for the team to extend.
* Make sound technical decisions around state management, data flow, error handling, performance, and UI architecture within the team's existing conventions.
* Write automated tests as part of every change — unit and widget tests, regression tests for every bug fix.
* Review code thoughtfully, identify risks early, and help other engineers improve implementation quality.
* Integrate backend APIs robustly: defensive parsing, error handling, retries, and graceful behavior over unreliable connectivity.
* Debug and fix performance, UI, networking, and platform\-specific issues using a methodical approach.
* Participate actively in product and design discussions, clarifying trade\-offs and calling out technical constraints early.
* Follow and help improve the team's engineering and AI practices for shipping safely and consistently.


 Required qualifications
 * 5\+ years of professional experience shipping production Flutter applications.
* Strong understanding of Dart, Flutter widgets, app lifecycle, asynchronous programming, rendering behavior, and at least one common state\-management approach.
* Experience owning production mobile features end to end, including technical design, implementation, testing, release, and post\-release fixes.
* Genuine commitment to automated testing: you've written widget tests with fakes or injected dependencies, and you see a failing\-first regression test as part of a bug fix, not overhead.
* Practical experience integrating real\-world APIs: JSON parsing that survives inconsistent responses, error states, retries, and offline\-aware behavior.
* Ability to debug methodically — reading stack traces, isolating layout and rebuild issues, profiling jank, and narrowing down platform\-specific problems.
* Comfort working within an established architecture and following team conventions, while suggesting improvements through discussion and evidence rather than unilateral rewrites.
* Ability to review others' code constructively and explain trade\-offs clearly.
* Clear written and spoken communication.
* Ability to work full\-time from our Bangalore office.


 Useful experience
 * Map\-based UIs such as Google Maps SDK or similar: markers, routes, camera control, geocoding, location permissions.
* Device\-connected, telematics, IoT, or real\-time mobile applications.
* Multi\-language apps and Flutter localization workflows (gen\-l10n or similar).
* Mobile CI/CD, release workflows, crash reporting, or app monitoring.
* Using AI coding tools productively within a governed workflow, and reviewing their output critically.
* Mentoring engineers or improving engineering practices across a small team.


 What we will look for
 * Strong hands\-on Flutter execution with senior\-level ownership and judgment.
* Craft and care in implementation — clean, maintainable choices over quick hacks.
* Ability to break down ambiguous requirements into safe, testable, reviewable increments.
* Ownership of your features end to end, including their tests, bugs, and production behavior.
* Curiosity about the domain: vehicles, telemetry, and the people who operate fleets.
* Receptiveness to review feedback and steady, reliable delivery.


 Your first 90 days
 * Ship your first features into the fleet app within your first few weeks, following the team's plan → test → implement workflow.
* Take ownership of a feature area, such as a dashboard module or the alerts flow, including its quality, test coverage, and maintainability.
* Contribute meaningful code reviews and help improve the team's Flutter engineering practices.
* Build enough product and domain context to make better technical trade\-offs independently.


 Hiring process
 1. Take\-home assignment — a practical Flutter exercise. Use AI or any modern tools of your choice; we care about the quality of what you ship and how well you understand it.
2. Assignment discussion \+ technical round — walk us through your solution and its trade\-offs, followed by a deeper technical discussion.
3. Final tech round — a closing round with the engineering team.

 Senior / Tech Lead Mobile Engineer

By leveraging adaptive AI and SaaS, we deliver personalized learning experiences that close critical gaps in traditional healthcare training and empower students, clinicians, and institutions worldwide. Operating at the intersection of EdTech and HealthTech, we are a fast\-moving, high\-growth startup building robust, enterprise\-grade learning technologies.
 



  





  





 THE ROLE:
 



 Orfiq is hiring a Senior / Tech Lead Mobile Engineer to take a leading role in building, scaling, and evolving our mobile platform across iOS and Android.
 



  





 This is a senior hands\-on engineering role for someone who can operate beyond feature
 



 delivery — shaping mobile architecture, API integrations, engineering standards, scalability, and technical direction as the product grows toward enterprise\-level adoption.
 



  





 You’ll work closely with frontend, backend, and web app teams across React Native, TypeScript, FastAPI, Node.js, .NET, and Azure.
 



  





 Operating in an agile, low\-bureaucracy startup culture, you will have high technical autonomy while collaborating daily with engineering leadership, product owners, and cross\-functional team members based in the United Kingdom.
 



  





 ⚠️ Selection Process Notice: Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a mandatory 10–15 minute automated AI video interview round as the immediate next step in our screening workflow. Please apply only if you are comfortable completing an asynchronous AI technical video screen upon selection.
 



  





  





 WHAT YOU WILL DO:
 



 ● Mobile Architecture \& Scalability: Lead the architecture, development, and continuous optimization of scalable cross\-platform applications across iOS and Android using React Native and TypeScript.
 



 ● Platform Evolution: Transition our mobile architecture from early/growth stage into a rock\-solid enterprise platform built for high concurrency, deep data security, and long\-term maintainability.
 



 ● API Integration \& BFF Strategy: Design and integrate scalable RESTful APIs and mobile\-facing backend services. Define clean API contracts and Backend\-for\-Frontend (BFF) patterns interfacing with FastAPI (Python), Node.js, and ASP.NET Core backends.
 



 ● Native Platform Extension: Step outside React Native to write native iOS (Swift/Objective\-C) or Android (Kotlin/Java) code whenever performance, hardware access, or native platform APIs demand it.
 



 ● Security \& Governance: Implement enterprise\-grade authentication, authorization, SSO integration (OAuth2, JWT), and secure encrypted on\-device caching.
 



 ● Store \& Release Automation: Own mobile CI/CD pipelines, code signing, staged rollouts, OTA updates, and production deployment across the Apple App Store and Google Play Store.
 



 ● Cross\-Border Collaboration: Work closely with our engineering team and leadership in the UK, driving architectural alignment, running code reviews, and establishing engineering best practices.
 



 Required Technical Skills \& Competencies
 



 ● Mobile Engineering Experience: 5\+ years of professional mobile development experience, with a proven track record operating at a Senior Engineer or Tech Lead level.
 



 ● React Native \& TypeScript: Deep commercial mastery of React Native, TypeScript,
 



 modern React paradigms (hooks, concurrency, state management), and mobile performance tuning.
 



 ● Architectural System Design: Demonstrable experience designing mobile application architectures from the ground up, including offline\-first patterns, state caching, and resilient network synchronization.
 



 ● Backend Integration Ecosystem: Solid hands\-on experience integrating mobile frontends with diverse backend architectures:
 



 ○ FastAPI / Python APIs
 



 ○ Node.js microservices / BFF layers
 



 ○ ASP.NET Core / .NET enterprise backend services
 



 ● Cloud \& Database Awareness: Familiarity with Microsoft Azure services and Azure SQL persistence layers.
 



 ● Mobile Security: Firm understanding of secure API communications, token lifecycle management (Keychain/Keystore), SSO implementations, and OWASP mobile security standards.
 



 ● Release Engineering: Complete ownership of mobile release lifecycles, app store guidelines, automated testing, and CI/CD automation (e.g., GitHub Actions, Fastlane).
 



 ● Startup Agility \& Collaboration: High agency, ability to manage technical debt pragmatically, and excellent communication skills for seamless distributed collaboration with our UK team.
 



  





  





 NICE TO HAVE:
 



 ● Direct experience writing custom React Native native bridges/modules in Swift, Objective\-C, Java, or Kotlin.
 



 ● Hands\-on familiarity with containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes/AKS) and cloud monitoring/telemetry.
 



 ● Prior experience in high\-compliance SaaS domains (HealthTech, MedTech, or EdTech).
 



  





  





 WHAT WE OFFER:
 



 ● Technical Ownership: Direct influence over platform architecture, technical tooling, and team standards with zero corporate red tape.
 



 ● Meaningful Global Impact: Build mission\-driven software that enhances training for healthcare professionals across the globe.
 



 ● Distributed, International Team: True remote flexibility with regular exposure to UK engineering leadership and international stakeholders.
 



 ● Competitive Compensation: Attractive package commensurate with senior engineering leadership capabilities.
 



  





 Orfiq AI Solutions Ltd is an equal opportunity employer

title: Forward Deployed Engineers
description:
**Summary**
 Forward Deployed Engineers are the engineering core of Avanade Next. They sit inside the client from week one and turn business ambition into production reality — proving the direction in Consulting with a working prototype, leading the build in Studios, and configuring products for client environments. They work alongside business stakeholders, Industry Reinvention Leads, Domain Architects, Value Architects and Trust Architects to understand what matters commercially, then build the system that delivers it.
   

  

 This is not a order\-taking role. Forward Deployed Engineers help clients decide what should be built, challenge assumptions where the value is not there, and lead the work through to live deployment. They work in small expert teams directing agent networks rather than large delivery pyramids, and they carry accountability from the first brief through to production — which is unusual, and is the point.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Work with clients, Industry Reinvention Leads, Domain Architects, Value Architects and Trust Architects to understand business priorities and translate them into practical AI\-enabled solutions.
* Build and deploy agentic AI systems end\-to\-end, embedded with the client and shipping from the first weeks of an engagement.
* Help clients identify where AI can create meaningful value, challenge assumptions where necessary, and shape solutions that are commercially viable and technically feasible at enterprise scale.
* In Consulting: build the working prototype that proves the strategy is real rather than theoretical.
* In Studios: take use cases from prototype to production\-grade agentic systems with the engineering rigour that implies.
* In Products: configure and deploy pre\-built agentic products into client environments.
* Design on the Avanade Agentic Platform and the Microsoft AI stack, choosing the right combination of Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry and AAP for the business problem.
* Apply AI\-native engineering practices — agent\-assisted development, automated evaluation, reusable components, observability and production operations.
* Work with Trust Architects on evaluation, accuracy and guardrails as part of the build, not as a later gate.
* Work with Value Architects so what is built stays connected to the measurable outcome it was funded for.
* Contribute reusable components, patterns and assets to the APAC IP library and the Avanade Agentic Platform on every engagement.
* Operate with high autonomy in the client's environment, including in the ambiguity of early\-stage discovery.


**KEY MEASURES**
* Client outcomes achieved through production deployments, evidenced by business value realised and client referenceability
* Production\-grade delivery on every engagement; no prototype handed over without a production path.
* Demonstrable productivity through AI\-native engineering practices and agent utilisation.
* Reusable assets contributed to the library from every engagement.
* Accuracy and evaluation thresholds met before release


**Qualifications**
**SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE**
* 5\+ years in software or AI engineering, with production systems to point to.
* Strong practical command of Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio, Azure OpenAI and agent orchestration; equivalent depth on another stack considered if the transfer is credible.
* Full\-stack capability — front end, APIs, data and agent orchestration — enough to ship something whole.
* Experience building and evaluating agentic systems, including retrieval, tool use, and failure handling.
* Comfortable being deployed into a client environment with high autonomy and direct exposure to stakeholders.
* Track record of turning a prototype into production at pace, without leaving the mess for someone else.
* Able to hold a business conversation as well as a technical one — comfortable in front of client stakeholders without an intermediary.
