title: Lead Engineer
description:
**About Runable** 




 Runable builds software that helps small and medium businesses grow — the tooling, automation, and workflows that let a lean team operate like a much larger one. We ship fast, own our work end to end, and measure success by what our customers actually get done.
 



  





**The Role** 




 We are hiring an Engineering Lead who is a backend\-heavy full stack builder. You will own services end to end: data model, API, business logic, background jobs, and the React screens that sit on top of them. Roughly 70% of your time is backend and systems work, 30% frontend.
 



 This is a builder role, not a ticket\-taking role. You will be given a problem and the context around it, and you are expected to come back with a design, ship it, and stand behind it in production.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Design, build, and operate backend services and REST/JSON APIs that power customer\-facing products.
* Own data modeling and database work in PostgreSQL — schema design, migrations, indexing, and query optimization.
* Build asynchronous and event\-driven flows: background jobs, queues, retries, idempotency, and scheduled work.
* Integrate third\-party systems (payments, email, CRM, messaging, LLM providers) with sane error handling and rate\-limit behavior.
* Build the frontend for the features you own in React and TypeScript — clean, fast, accessible screens, not throwaway UI.
* Instrument what you ship: logging, metrics, alerts, and dashboards, so failures are visible before customers report them.
* Improve reliability and performance — find the slow query, the N\+1, the memory leak, the cache that should exist, and fix it.
* Review peers' code, write the design docs that matter, and keep the codebase something the next engineer can work in.
* Participate in on\-call rotation for the services you own, and drive incident follow\-ups to closure.



  





**Requirements** 



* 5–9 years of professional software engineering experience, with the majority of it on backend systems.
* Strong command of at least one backend language used in production at scale — TypeScript/Node.js preferred; strong Python, Go, or Java experience with willingness to work primarily in TypeScript is welcome.
* Deep, practical PostgreSQL (or comparable relational database) experience: you can explain a query plan, design a schema for a real product, and migrate it safely with live traffic.
* Proven experience designing and shipping APIs consumed by real clients — versioning, pagination, auth, error contracts.
* Working knowledge of React and modern frontend fundamentals: component structure, state management, forms, and API integration.
* Comfortable with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or similar), containers, CI/CD, and deploying your own code.
* Solid grasp of caching, queues, and background processing (Redis, SQS/Kafka/BullMQ or equivalents).
* Testing discipline — unit and integration tests, and a clear view of what is worth testing.
* Strong debugging skills in production environments and the judgment to know when to patch versus when to fix properly.
* Clear written and verbal communication; you can explain a tradeoff to a non\-engineer.



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Experience at a startup or on a small team where you owned a service end to end.
* Multi\-tenant SaaS experience — tenancy models, per\-tenant limits, billing, and usage metering.
* Experience building with LLM APIs, agents, or workflow automation in production.
* Payments and subscription billing (Stripe or similar).
* Infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform, Pulumi) and observability tooling (OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Sentry, Datadog).
* Experience mentoring engineers or leading a small project team.



  





**What Success Looks Like** 




**Timeframe** 




**Expected outcome** 




 First 30 days
 



 Environment set up, first features shipped to production, familiar with the core data model and services.
 



 First 60 days
 



 Owning a service or product area end to end, contributing to design reviews, closing reliability gaps you found yourself.
 



 First 90 days
 



 Leading delivery of a significant backend project, measurably improving performance or reliability of the area you own, and raising the bar in code review.
 



  





**Our Stack** 




 TypeScript across the stack, Node.js/Bun services, PostgreSQL, Redis, React, REST APIs, Docker, and cloud\-hosted infrastructure with CI/CD. We are pragmatic about tools — the right choice is the one the team can operate at 3am.
 



  





**Why Runable** 



* Real ownership: you pick the design, ship it, and see the customer impact within weeks.
* Small team, high leverage — your work reaches SMB customers who feel the difference immediately.
* Direct access to founders and customers; short feedback loops, minimal process.
* Compensation is benchmarked to experience and impact, and discussed openly in the first conversation.

description:
**About Impact Analytics**
 Impact Analytics is an agentic\-first AI software company transforming retail merchandising through cutting\-edge AI, LLMs, and Generative AI technologies. As a fast\-growing Series D company with deployments across five continents, it is building both industry\-leading merchandising solutions and foundational AI agents that are redefining how retail decisions are made.
   

  

 What makes Impact Analytics unique is its combination of deep retail domain expertise, strong innovation culture, and global presence. It is one of the few India\-born AI companies recognized globally by organizations like Fortune, Gartner, and the Inc. 5000\.
   

  

 For candidates looking to work on next\-generation AI products with global scale and real\-world impact, Impact Analytics is an exciting place to build your career. Here’s a link to our website: www.impactanalytics.co.
   

  

**The impact that you will be making**
* Build and own key features for Native Android applications, with mobile as the primary focus.
* Design reliable offline\-first experiences for intermittent, slow, or restricted connectivity.
* Partner with Backend engineers on API contracts, synchronization, data models, and error handling.
* Own mobile quality across performance, reliability, usability, and device compatibility.
* Contribute to web frontend development and reusable frontend patterns.
* Participate in architecture and technical decisions across Mobile and Web.
* Write high\-quality, testable code and contribute to unit, integration, and UI automation.
* Support UAT, phased rollouts, production validation, and releases.


**What Lands You In This Role**
**Must have**
* 4–7 years of hands\-on software development experience, with strong expertise in Native Android and good experience with web frontend development.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Kotlin/Java, Android SDK, Jetpack, lifecycle management, background processing, and modern Android development.
* Strong understanding of Android architecture, including MVVM/MVI, modularization, dependency injection, state management, and clean architecture.
* Experience building offline\-first Android applications, including local persistence, synchronization, conflict resolution, retries, eventual consistency, and unreliable network handling.
* Experience with REST/gRPC APIs and mobile\-backend integration.
* Strong understanding of Android performance and reliability, including startup time, memory/CPU usage, rendering, ANRs, battery, and network efficiency.
* Good experience with React and TypeScript, including responsive web applications, component architecture, state management, and API integration.
* Strong understanding of JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and web performance.
* Strong understanding of Git, code reviews, automated testing, and CI/CD.
* Strong problem\-solving and debugging skills across the mobile and API layers.
* Ability to collaborate with Product, Backend, QA, Architecture, and UX teams.


**Good to have**
* Jetpack Compose, Room, WorkManager, Coroutines, and Flow.
* Next.js or similar modern web technologies.
* Experience with mobile CI/CD, Firebase, GCP, crash monitoring, and performance monitoring.
* Experience handling large datasets, high\-SKU environments, and low\-bandwidth networks.
* Experience in retail, logistics, field\-service, or enterprise applications.


**What We Offer**
* An opportunity to develop some of the best enterprise SaaS products to be built out of India
* Opportunities to quench your thirst for problem\-solving, experimenting, learning, and implementing innovative solutions
* A flat, collegial work environment, with a work hard, play hard attitude
* A platform for rapid growth if you are willing to try new things without fear of failure.
* Remuneration with best in class industry standards with generous health insurance cover.


**Some of our accolades include**
* Ranked as one of America's Fastest\-Growing Companies by Financial Times for five consecutive years: 2020\-2024\.
* Ranked as one of America's Fastest\-Growing Private Companies by Inc. 5000 for seven consecutive years: 2018\-2024\.
* Voted \#1 by more than 300 retailers worldwide in the RIS Software LeaderBoard 2024 report.
* Ranked \#72 in America’s Most Innovative Companies list in 2023—by Fortune—alongside companies like Microsoft, Tesla, Apple, IBM, etc.
* Forged a strategic partnership with Google to equip retailers with cutting\-edge generative AI tools.
* Recognized in multiple Gartner reports, including Market Guides and Hype Cycle, spanning assortments, merchandising, forecasting, algorithmic retailing, and Unified Price, Promotion, and Markdown Optimization Applications

title: Software Engineer (Kotlin)
description:
**This is Adyen**
 Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H\&M, and Microsoft \- making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition.
   

  

 For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster.
   

  

**Kotlin Engineer**
 Adyen is looking for full\-time Kotlin Engineers to help us develop our in\-person payments solution. We have a large and varied fleet of payment terminals in the field, which we are continuously improving by adding new features and payment methods. Kotlin development plays a vital role in this effort, as your code will be deployed across our various solutions using Kotlin Multiplatform.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 As a Kotlin Engineer you will work on solutions for our payment terminals featuring many capabilities, such as\-
   

  

* Accepting payments using credit cards and debit cards, Apple Pay or Google Pay on mobile phones or accepting payments through QR codes;
* Communication with the Adyen backend to achieve one platform solution;
* Integration with a variety of cash registers using state of the art standards.


 You will be working on developing our main business logic in Kotlin, which will be deployed on both Android and Linux based payment terminals, and on our backend.
   

  

 Your code is tested using a variety of testing methods. These methods range from unit testing to complete product testing via automated programmable robots in order to offer a stable and feature rich solution to all of our merchants.
   

  

 We value your opinion and ideas. You are encouraged to propose improvements, new solutions for your team and the platform. You will also have the freedom and opportunity to work on projects that will bring innovation and keep Adyen ahead of their competition. Since with freedom comes responsibility, you are expected to take ownership of the feature you work on, and be involved from design, implementation, testing and monitoring of the new functionality as well as to ensure a sustainable and secure solution.
   

  

 At Adyen we have a development team working with various technologies. When you love to solve hard technical problems effectively, take ownership and want to work as part of an efficient team of professionals please reach out! We are constantly looking for the right balance between elegant solutions and time\-to\-market. In other words, you have the opportunity to work in a comfortable but dynamic and challenging environment.
   

  

**Your Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of cumulative development experience in Android/Kotlin;
* 3\+ years of experience in software design and development in Kotlin;
* Knowledge on databases (Postgresql, SQLite;)
* Able to communicate fluently in English.


**Nice to have**
* Experience with Kotlin Multiplatform for cross\-platform development;
* Additional programming knowledge/experience \- Android, C/C\+\+, Python
* Card payment (EMV, ISO8583, ISO20022\) knowledge.


**Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitments**
 Our unique approach is a product of our diverse perspectives. This diversity of backgrounds and cultures is essential in helping us maintain our momentum. Our business and technical challenges are unique, and we need as many different voices as possible to join us in solving them \- voices like yours. No matter who you are or where you’re from, we welcome you to be your true self at Adyen.
   

  

 Studies show that women and members of underrepresented communities apply for jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Does this sound like you? If so, Adyen encourages you to reconsider and apply. We look forward to your application!
   

  

**What’s next?**
 Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. Learn more about our hiring process here. Don’t be afraid to let us know if you need more flexibility.
   

  

 This role is based out of our Bengaluru office. We are an office\-first company and value in\-person collaboration; we do not offer remote\-only roles.

title: Software Engineering Lead
description:
**About Airbound**
**Our mission is to make a world where everyone has access to delivery. Where goods move as freely as information moves today.**
 This is possible. Today the cost of moving on a scooter is ₹2/km. That’s the cost of moving a 150kg mass from point A to B. We’re bringing that mass down to less than 5kgs, concurrently bringing the cost down to 10 paise/km. This is how we make deliveries a reality. This is how we create a world where we’re doing billions of deliveries per day.
   

  

 The tech is not there. The current cost of drone delivery is ₹100/km. We need to completely redefine the way things are done here. We’re building the world’s most efficient aircraft from the ground\-up, and scaling that up to beyond anything the aerospace sector has ever seen. This cannot be an iterative process. We have to tear down all conventions and build everything up from scratch.
   

  

 To do this, we need nothing less than the best engineers. The ones who care about building something fundamentally different, who are deeply curious about understanding the fundamentals of everything they’re working on, who are dreamers that believe in the impossible.
   

  

**About Flight Systems**
 The hardware on the drone is only half of what keeps it up in the air. The rest is the software both on the craft and on our ground station. Our unique dual motor thrust vectored tailsitter with blended wing body design has to fly in almost all weather\-including heavy winds and light rains autonomously. We're targeting 1000s of flights per day across all locations, requiring us to rethink everything from firmware, controls, state estimation to even ground control and fleet management software. We've achieved an industry\-leading payload\-to\-weight ratio of \~2kg drone for 1kg payload and we're pushing this even further. Every gram matters when you're revolutionizing logistics. This is where cutting\-edge aerospace engineering meets software scalability meets real\-world impact. If you get excited about solving problems that span multiple disciplines that don't have textbook solutions, this is your playground.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking an experienced Full Stack Engineer to join our team dedicated to developing a suite of sophisticated, web\-based platforms for UAV operations. This role is central to building the software that powers our entire ecosystem, including our next\-generation Ground Control Station (GCS), fleet management dashboards, data analysis tools, and simulation interfaces. This position is integral to our core mission, contributing directly to the safety and efficiency of our real\-world autonomous operations.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Platform Development: Architect, develop, and deploy robust, end\-to\-end features across our various web\-based UAV platforms
* Front\-End Engineering: Construct dynamic and highly responsive user interfaces using React for the visualization of real\-time telemetry, interactive mission planning, and complex data analysis
* Back\-End Engineering: Engineer high\-throughput, low\-latency backend services using NestJS to reliably process UAV data streams, manage command\-and\-control logic, and parse specialized communication protocols
* Full Lifecycle Ownership: Actively participate in all phases of the agile software development lifecycle (SDLC), from requirements gathering and design to implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance
* Software Excellence: Champion and adhere to software development best practices, including Test\-Driven Development (TDD), to ensure exceptional code quality, system reliability, and performance in a mission\-critical environment
* Technical Documentation: Create and maintain clear, concise technical documentation for the systems and features you develop, including architectural diagrams, API specifications, and operational runbooks
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Work with cross\-functional teams to translate complex requirements into robust technical solutions


**Qualifications**
 Must\-Have
   

  

* A minimum of 7\+ years of professional experience in full\-stack software development, preferably with exposure to real\-time systems
* Front\-End Technologies: Advanced proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and React, with demonstrated experience building complex, data\-driven user interfaces
* Back\-End Technologies: Advanced proficiency in backend development with Node.js and extensive hands\-on experience with the NestJS framework
* Database Systems: Hands\-on experience with both SQL (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL (e.g., MongoDB) databases, including schema design and query optimization
* Networking: A strong understanding of core networking principles, including the TCP/IP suite and UDP, with practical experience implementing real\-time communication using WebSockets
* Data Stream Processing: Experience developing systems that process and manage continuous, high\-frequency data streams
* Software Engineering Fundamentals:
+ Strong test\-driven development and profiling expertise for safety\-critical systems
+ Mastery of Git workflows and collaborative development practices
+ Application of SOLID principles and embedded software best practices
+ Excellent documentation and communication skills for cross\-functional collaboration


 Good to Have

* Data Visualization: Proficiency with libraries such as D3\.js, Chart.js, Mapbox, or Leaflet
* Data Pipelines: Familiarity with message brokers (e.g., RabbitMQ, Kafka) or time\-series databases (e.g., InfluxDB, TimescaleDB)

title: Mobile Engineer
description:
**About Us** 




 Scapia! A credit card that's out there to make travel happen for people, by converting their everyday expenses into travel experiences. We're a bunch of passionate people who work together, brainstorm, and debate with each other, and don't stop until we're proud of our work. Customer delight tops everything else! We've worked hard to create an environment of honesty and passion that sets everyone up for success.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for mobile engineers with 2 to 6 years of experience to join the frontend team at Scapia. You will be placed in a pod based on where your strengths fit.
 



 We build in Flutter, and you do not need to have written it before. If you have shipped and owned a consumer app at scale in Kotlin, Swift or React Native, you have the part that takes years. Dart and Bloc take weeks, and we will give you those weeks.
 



 You will work across surfaces spanning card onboarding and servicing, UPI and bill payments, travel search and checkout, rewards, and the shared design system beneath them. You will collaborate closely with design, backend, product and our bank and supplier partner teams to take a surface from spec through to a staged production rollout.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 




  





**Feature Ownership** 



* Own customer\-facing surfaces end to end, from problem definition and technical design through rollout, adoption metrics and the on\-call that follows.
* Set the technical direction for your surface and make the architecture calls that keep it changeable a year from now.
* Partner with design, product and backend to turn ambiguous problem statements into shipped, measured experiences.
* Contribute to the shared design system and widget library that every surface at Scapia is built on.



**Cards and Payments** 



* Build and scale the card experience across onboarding, activation, limits, statements, EMI and rewards.
* Deliver payment experiences that are fast, reliable and compliant, spanning UPI, bill payments and card transactions.
* Shape how the app adapts to multiple bank partners, so that a single change ships safely across every programme.



**Travel Commerce** 



* Build high\-converting search, booking and checkout journeys across flights, stays, trains, buses, visas and experiences.
* Create discovery and merchandising surfaces that help customers evaluate options and choose with confidence.
* Own post\-booking experiences spanning cancellations, refunds, rewards and customer communication.



**App Health and Performance** 



* Continuously improve app performance, stability and size across ANRs, crashes, startup time and memory.
* Strengthen observability through crash reporting, instrumentation and analytics that teams can act on.
* Advance release engineering, including staged rollouts, remote kill switches and over\-the\-air patching on Android and iOS.



  





**How We Build** 




 Every change here starts as a written spec, reviewed and approved before implementation begins. AI agents do a lot of what comes after: generating implementation from an approved spec, turning Figma components into design system code, cleaning up dead flags. The review bar has not changed. You own the design, you review the diff, and you answer for it in production.
 



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* 2 to 6 years building mobile apps in Flutter, Kotlin, Swift or React Native, including at least one consumer app you shipped to a store and then owned in production.
* Depth in the fundamentals that outlast any framework: render and lifecycle model, state management, memory, threading and offline behaviour.
* Ability to read a crash report or a trace and work backwards to the cause, and to pick up an unfamiliar stack quickly.
* Clear written communication. Specs, pull request descriptions and incident notes are a large part of the job.
* Comfort with ownership: your own builds, the pager for your surface, and your own production debugging.



  





**Good to Have** 



* Flutter and Dart in production, particularly with Bloc or Cubit.
* Native Android (Kotlin) or iOS (Swift) depth, which stays useful here for platform channels, ANRs and store tooling.
* Prior experience in fintech, payments, travel or another regulated or transaction\-led domain.
* Startup mindset: comfortable with ambiguity, fast iteration, and wearing multiple hats.

title: Workflow Engineer
description:
**About the Company** 




**Join the Rocketship 🚀** 




 We’re building
 **ShopOS** 
 —
 **AI agents powering the entire ecommerce stack.** 
 Already past PMF, we’re scaling fast and shaping the future of how online brands are built with AI. Co\-founded by seasoned builders with multiple successful exits to companies like
 **Flipkart** 
 and
 **Polygon Labs** 
 — and
 **backed by Binny Bansal** 
 — this isn’t just another start\-up. It’s your
 **front\-row seat to the next big shift in ecommerce.** 




  





**Watch** 
 :
 **What is ShopOS (from the founders’ lens \- Click here)** 




  





**About the Role** 




 As a Workflow Engineer at ShopOS, you'll be responsible for building the backbone of automation that powers our AI\-native commerce stack — and then owning it. That means designing and implementing modular, node\-based workflow systems that integrate across catalog management, creative tools, personalization engines, and fulfillment systems, but it also means being the person who fixes them when they break, upgrades them as we scale, and documents them well enough that anyone on the team can pick them up.
 



 This role is for engineers who enjoy solving complex logic puzzles, who think in flows and systems rather than one\-off deliverables, and who want to make things smarter, faster, and more reliable — not just build them once and move on. You'll work closely with product, AI, and design teams to turn business rules into reusable, low\-code/no\-code automations that deliver outsized leverage to our users.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 



* Build node\-based, rule\-driven workflows that support eCommerce operations and AI agent interactions
* Develop modular workflow components that can be composed into reusable, logic\-driven flows
* Integrate with APIs, data systems, and 3rd\-party services (Shopify, Stripe, Zapier, etc.)
* Diagnose and fix bugs in live workflows — including ones you didn't originally build
* Upgrade and refactor existing workflows for better reliability, speed, and cost
* Audit workflows on a regular cadence — flag fragile, redundant, or failure\-prone flows before they cause problems
* Maintain clear documentation for every workflow: what it does, what it depends on, what breaks it, how to fix it
* Set up admin interfaces and audit tools to monitor workflow health and performance
* Partner with product managers and designers to make workflows intuitive, testable, and transparent to end\-users
* Collaborate with AI/ML engineers to embed intelligence into decision points
* Own end\-to\-end delivery of key internal or external workflows (e.g. onboarding, content pipelines, personalization loops)
* Bring creative, non\-obvious solutions to recurring operational problems — not just the standard fix



**What We're Looking For** 



* CS background, with solid coding fundamentals
* Proficient in JavaScript and TypeScript
* Comfortable with Python for scripting and automation logic
* Hands\-on experience with node\-based / visual workflow builders (we currently run on Make; familiarity with n8n, Zapier, or similar counts too)
* Familiarity with Figma, Weavy, and ComfyUI
* Thinks in frameworks and systems rather than one\-off deliverables
* Strong debugging discipline — able to trace a failure across multiple connected systems, not just one node
* Comfortable with API integration (REST/GraphQL) and external services
* 2–4 years of experience — we're actively open to junior CS grads. Regardless of experience level, everyone gets trained on our systems, so raw fundamentals and problem\-solving instinct matter more than years on a resume



**Bonus Points** 



* Deep understanding of workflow engines, state machines, or rule engines
* Experience with event\-driven architectures and queueing systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS)
* Working knowledge of Postgres and Redis
* Comfortable with infra\-as\-code (Docker, Terraform), monitoring, and CI/CD
* Experience with other low\-code/no\-code or visual workflow tools (Temporal, Langchain, Camunda, Retool)
* Exposure to AI/LLM systems and how workflows interface with prompt generation, chaining, etc.
* Previous experience in commerce, logistics, or creative ops automation
* Built internal ops tools or dashboards from scratch in a fast\-moving startup
* Familiarity with configuration\-driven or metadata\-driven engineering



**You'll Thrive If You Are…** 



* A builder who thinks in flows, states, and transitions
* Obsessed with making systems smarter, faster, and self\-healing
* Pragmatic about complexity — knowing when to write code and when to wire blocks
* Solution\-first — you show up with fixes, not just problem reports
* A team player who enjoys working across product, design, and AI teams
* Excited by the idea of creating leverage and automation for every human in the loop

title: Android Developer [HOA]
description:
**About The Opportunity**
 This role is not just about building screens. You will work on apps where user journeys are directly linked to task completion, offer discovery, ad engagement, reward eligibility, wallet balance, referrals, retention, and revenue outcomes. The Android app is the core product surface where users discover offers, complete actions, earn rewards, interact with ads, and keep coming back.
   

  

 We are looking for an Android Engineer who can build reliable, fast, and scalable app experiences for high\-volume user flows. Someone who understands that in incentive\-led apps, small issues like delayed reward updates, broken deep links, slow offer loading, poor ad placement, or crashes on low\-end devices can directly impact revenue, user trust, and retention.
   

  

**What You’ll Work On**
 You will own Android development across GreedyGame’s Incent App and House of Apps portfolio, including:
   

  

* Reward\-based user journeys such as offer listing, task completion, reward status, wallet, referrals, and user activity tracking
* App monetization flows including rewarded ads, interstitials, native placements, banners, offerwall, and ad\-led engagement modules
* Consumer app features across gaming and utility app categories where retention, session time, and ad revenue are key business metrics
* Campaign\-driven experiences where different users may see different offers, tasks, rewards, and monetization placements
* App\-side integrations with backend systems for user events, offer tracking, reward validation, fraud signals, and campaign visibility
* Performance improvements for scale\-heavy Android apps running across a wide range of devices and OS versions


**Role \& Responsibilities**
* Build and maintain Android applications for Incent Apps, Offerwall\-led products, and House of Apps
* Develop user flows for offer discovery, task completion, reward unlocks, wallet updates, referrals, user milestones, and engagement loops
* Integrate ad monetization SDKs and optimize ad placements without breaking user experience
* Work on app\-side event tracking to ensure user actions, offer completions, ad impressions, clicks, reward triggers, and funnel drops are captured accurately
* Collaborate with Product and Growth teams to run experiments around offer visibility, reward positioning, onboarding, retention, and monetization
* Partner with Backend teams to integrate APIs for campaign listing, user eligibility, reward status, transaction history, and fraud checks
* Debug app issues that directly impact business metrics, including broken reward flows, incorrect tracking, delayed status updates, crashes, ANRs, and low\-end device performance problems
* Improve app performance around launch time, screen load time, API failures, offline handling, memory usage, and crash\-free sessions
* Own Android releases across internal testing, QA builds, Play Store rollout, staged releases, versioning, and hotfixes
* Maintain clean, modular, and scalable Android code using modern Android architecture


**Skills \& QualificationsMust\-Have**
* 3\-6 years of hands\-on experience in Android app development using Kotlin
* Must to have understanding of Android SDK, Jetpack Compose, MVVM, Coroutines, Room DB, REST APIs, and Gradle
* 2 years of experience building consumer\-facing Android applications where performance, reliability, and user experience matter
* Strong debugging skills across crashes, ANRs, memory leaks, API failures, and device\-specific issues
* Good understanding of app lifecycle, background tasks, push notifications, deep links, local storage, and app state handling
* Ability to work with Product, Design, Backend, QA, and Growth teams to convert business requirements into stable Android features
* Comfortable working in fast release cycles with experiments, product iterations, and production fixes


**Strongly Preferred**
* Experience working on reward apps, cashback apps, gaming apps, utility apps, loyalty apps, fintech consumer apps, or offerwall products
* Experience with ad monetization SDKs such as AdMob, AppLovin, Meta Audience Network, Unity Ads, ironSource, or similar
* Understanding of event tracking, attribution, and analytics tools such as Firebase, GA4, AppsFlyer, Branch, or similar
* Exposure to reward systems, wallet flows, referral systems, user eligibility, transaction history, or payout\-related flows
* Experience optimizing apps for low\-end Android devices and unstable network conditions
* Understanding of ProGuard/R8, app size optimization, remote config, A/B testing, and Play Store release management


**What Good Looks Like In This Role**
* Users are able to discover offers, complete tasks, and receive reward status updates without confusion or delay
* Ad placements improve monetization without making the app feel spammy or broken
* App events are tracked accurately so Product and Growth teams can trust funnel and revenue data
* Crashes, ANRs, slow screens, and broken reward flows are identified and fixed quickly
* New experiments can be shipped fast without destabilizing the app
* The Android codebase becomes easier to scale across multiple apps in the House of Apps portfolio

title: Forward Deployed Engineer - Intern
description:
**Forward Deployed Engineer — Intern**
**Blue Machines AI**
 Location: Bangalore (in\-office) \| Duration: \[3\-6] months, full\-time \| Reports to: Engineering Manager, Forward Deployed Engineering
   

  

**About The Role**
 Blue Machines AI builds enterprise CX systems for clients in banking, insurance, health insurance and e\-commerce — voice agents, workflow automation, and the integrations that tie both into the customer's existing stack.
   

  

 Forward Deployed Engineers own live accounts: keeping deployments healthy, root\-causing what breaks, and turning interaction data into decisions for both the client and our product team. As an intern, you will work on real accounts from week one, alongside the FDE who owns them.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Map and configure client workflows on the platform — the full journey across voice, backend systems and human handoff, not just a single agent turn
* Run root cause analysis on production issues: trace a failed interaction across logs, integration calls and workflow steps down to a specific cause, then write it up so it does not recur
* Build and maintain the integrations these workflows run on — REST APIs, webhooks, CRM / ticketing / core system connections — and debug them when auth, payloads or timeouts break
* Own account reporting: containment and deflection rates, drop\-off points, latency, resolution rates — including the queries and dashboards behind the numbers
* Analyse call transcripts and workflow logs at volume to find failure patterns and quantify their impact before proposing a fix
* Support UAT and go\-lives with scenario testing across the whole workflow, plus defect logging and triage
* Document RCAs, runbooks and configuration so an account can be handed over cleanly
* Track your work in JIRA and join the daily standup


**Must have**
* Final\-year student or recent graduate in CS / IT / Engineering, or equivalent self\-taught ability
* Python or JavaScript/TypeScript at a working level — enough to script, parse logs and call APIs
* SQL and genuine comfort with data — you can pull the number yourself, not just read a dashboard
* REST APIs, JSON, and a real debugging instinct: able to follow a problem across systems rather than stopping at the first error message
* Clear written English — RCAs and client updates are written deliverables
* Structured thinker who documents as they go


**Good to have**
* A BI or analytics tool (Metabase, Looker, Power BI or similar)
* Postman, Git

title: Senior Lead Software Engineer -Java/Kotlin , Python programmer, APIs
description:
**Job Description**
 We have an exciting and rewarding opportunity for you to take your software engineering career to the next level. We are building a next\-generation, AI\-driven, cloud\-native Supervision \& Surveillance product that monitors enterprise digital communications for compliance violations, misconduct, and policy breaches at massive scale.
   

  

 As a Sr. Software Engineer/Lead Engineer at JPMorgan Chase within the digital communications compliance team, you will design and implement core backend services, streaming pipelines, and data flows that power our detection logic, alert triage, reviewer workflows, and explainable audit trails. You will work across billions of communications and content events, collaborating with product managers, architects, data science, platform, and operations teams, while engaging with engineering communities to explore new and emerging technologies.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Design and develop scalable, fault\-tolerant microservices and APIs that support rule\-based and ML\-based detection pipelines, evaluating performance and cost trade\-offs.Model and implement supervision and reviewer workflows using state machines (alert triage, queues, escalations, dispositions).
* Build streaming and batch data pipelines that ingest, index, and enrich communications content and the alerts generated on that content, with APIs for upstream and downstream integrations.
* Design data models for Alerts, Queues, Policies, and audit artifacts, ensuring immutability, lineage, and full traceability for audits.
* Operationalize ML and LLM models into detection and alert\-generation pipelines in partnership with Data Science and ML Engineering.
* Build robust unit, integration, and performance tests aligned to an ideal test pyramid, following Test\-Driven Development.
* Sets and scales operating practices for enterprise\-authorized AI\-assisted engineering and SDLC/TLM automation across multiple teams to improve delivery speed, quality, and operational outcomes; establishes measurable expectations (e.g., throughput, defect reduction, reliability) and ensures consistent validation, security, resiliency, and reuse of proven patterns.
* Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise\-authorized AI\-assisted development and automation capabilities, to drive efficiency and support capacity unlock initiatives across teams, prioritizing reuse of existing firm technology assets.
* Build CI/CD pipelines with automated quality\-control gates across the delivery lifecycle and implement observability hooks \- metrics, tracing, and logging, to reduce production toil through proactive monitoring and troubleshooting.
* Partner with product management and compliance SMEs to monitor and improve the accuracy, reliability, and false\-positive rates of generated alerts.
* Proactively identify hidden problems and patterns in communications data and use those insights to improve detection quality and drive product and process improvements.


**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**
* 8\+ years building resilient, scalable, cost\-efficient, enterprise\-grade cloud\-native products, with 2\+ years in compliance for the financial industry.
* Expert Java/Kotlin and Python programmer with experience building headless, externally consumable APIs.
* Experience building cloud\-native microservices for streaming and batch architectures using Spark and/or Flink.
* Well versed with AWS services, including but not limited to EC2, ECS, EKS, EMR, S3, and Glacier and hands\-on with Elastic/OpenSearch, Kafka, and PostgreSQL and experience integrating and operationalizing ML/LLM models and pipelines in production.
* Hands\-on with AI productivity tools such as GitHub Copilot and Qodo (Codium).
* Experience leading multi\-team adoption of enterprise\-authorized AI\-assisted development and delivery tools, including defining governance/ways of working (human\-in\-the\-loop validation, quality gates), measuring outcomes, and ensuring secure handling of sensitive inputs/outputs.
* Strong understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, resiliency/security implications, and control expectations; ability to coach managers/leads and influence leaders on safe scaling patterns.
* Experience with observability and monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry.
* Experience building CI/CD pipelines using ArgoCD, Helm, Terraform, Jenkins, and GitHub Actions.
* Prior experience in Test\-Driven Development, delivering products with well\-defined SLI/SLO/SLAs and strong ownership mentality with excellent communication skills and a collaborative mindset.
* Experience mentoring engineers and providing technical leadership at a senior level.


**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**
* Familiarity with modern front\-end technologies and MLOps in the cloud, strom is a plus.
* Experience building cost models aligned to SLIs/SLOs.
* Exposure to data privacy, PII handling, and encryption in a regulated environment.


**ABOUT US**
